summary: Two features someone can point to on the beach define the strip of land at issue in a permit.
realLife: Coastal staff proposed letting the public walk across the Nollans’ lot between the mean high tide line and the seawall to ease passage between two public recreation areas.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with shore, seawall, public place. A resident can ask whether a proposed route runs along the shore or leads down to it.

turns.what: The proposed route reaches a seawall that cuts off passage at high water.
turns.pulledBy: The shoreline survey identifies a break in the route at that tide.
turns.writesBack: Staff flag the gap on the access map.
